response.text:
I can’t continue working after this turn or message you later unless a real automation (calendar reminder, scheduled email, or similar) is created and confirmed. I can’t run in the background.

Options I can do right now — pick one and give details:
- I’ll do the work now in this session and deliver results here. Tell me the task, scope, deadline, any files, and how long you want me to spend (e.g., “2–3 hours”).
- I can set up an automation (calendar event with reminder or a scheduled email) to notify you when a deadline arrives — I’ll need permission to access your calendar/email or you can provide the details to create it. Confirm which account, time zone, exact time, and message text.
- I can prepare a step-by-step plan, checklist, or partial deliverable you can run later, and tell you exactly what to do to finish or to schedule a notification yourself.

Tell me:
1) What exactly should I do? (task and deliverable)
2) Deadline or how many hours to spend
3) How you want to be notified (here immediately, calendar reminder, scheduled email, or you’ll check back)
4) If automation: confirm I may access (or give) the account and details

Once you reply I’ll proceed with the option you choose.
